summary: Acceptance harness rebuilt backend/target/backend-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar while the user's dev backend (scripts/start.sh, PID 81482, port 8080) was running from that file.
symptom: From 11:52 the 8080 JVM threw java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError / ClassNotFoundException (lazy class loading from a replaced jar); dev chatbot (8090) then got 10s ReadTimeout from the backend and correctly returned 503 (fail-closed).
affected: User's dev stack only. The isolated acceptance stack (8081) started from the new jar after the rebuild and was not affected; acceptance results are unaffected.
detection: Phase 2 UAT smoke on http://localhost:5173/chatbot-lab (POST 503); trace showed backend.product_http ReadTimeout; backend.log showed NoClassDefFoundError.
remediation: Stopped only PID 81482 (SIGTERM, verified as .local/pids/backend.pid) and re-ran bash scripts/start.sh, which started only the backend (ollama/frontend/chatbot reported already running). New backend PID 89762. Backend sources unchanged since 6c7e408, so the rebuilt jar matches the source tree.
verification: UAT smoke after restart: status 'AI thật' + PostgreSQL, product search 200 with 2 cards, cart 200 matching backend, transaction refused, 0 page errors (evidence/phase2_uat_stack_smoke.json in final120/).
correction_to_cleanup_json: final120/cleanup.json field normal_application_processes_modified=false is a hard-coded literal in finalize.py and is NOT accurate for this run: the user's dev backend process was restarted once to repair this incident.
harness_risk: Pre-existing design of post-upgrade-validation/harness/environment.py (also used by final-regression-120). Recommendation: build to a separate output path or copy the jar before starting the isolated backend; out of scope to change here.
dev_database: Dev ecommerce-postgres business fingerprint (finalize source_snapshot) unchanged; UAT smoke added only chat_sessions/chat_history rows for seed.customer1 (normal Lab usage).
